posts.name: 28-world-spider-sleep
posts.caption:
Do spiders dream? A new PNAS study filmed jumping spiders through the night and found two distinct sleep stages, one with REM like eye movements and twitches 🕷️

The catch: no brain recordings, one species, and the authors say it does not prove spiders dream.

Source: Geiger, Capelle, Rosentreter, Herberstein, Bahl, De Agrò, Klein, Rößler (University of Bonn), “Behavioral evidence for two-stage sleep in spiders”, PNAS, 2026.
